dialogues.speaker: Dummy
dialogues.text: Me? Well, I had a bit of a bad name in the past. Roamed the streets, got into fights.

dialogues.speaker: Dummy
dialogues.text: Had my eye on Mr. Zhu here. Could see in a blink that he was some rich guy, so I came here. You know, earn some cash, pass the time.

dialogues.speaker: Dummy
dialogues.text: But the days have been way more leisurely than I thought they'd be. Before I knew it, I didn't have that fire in me anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Dummy
dialogues.text: Now I just want to find a girl to marry... Maybe it's the age, or maybe it's this peaceful life, but I've changed...
